C0219.title: Supermarket 'Collusion' Click Farming to Defraud Subsidies: Shanghai Police Crack 'Order A Ship B' Scam
C0219.summary: In March 2025, Shanghai police dismantled a click farming fraud targeting an e-commerce platform. Suspects Dai and Zhu organized offline supermarket staff to conduct fake transactions using an 'Order A, Ship B' scheme—placing online orders but shipping empty packages or cheap substitutes to illicitly obtain platform coupons and rebates, involving over 1.2 million yuan.
